# get flux data
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(maps)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)


keep <- c("TIMESTAMP_START", "TIMESTAMP_END", "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F",
          "NETRAD", "G_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS_QC", "LE_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS_QC",
          "NEE_VUT_REF", "NEE_VUT_REF_QC", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")

read_hh <- function(zip_file) {
  # find the half-hourly FLUXMET file inside this zip
  hh_name <- grep("FLUXMET_HH", unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE)[1]
  # unzip only that csv
  unzip(zip_file, files = hh_name, exdir = "data/raw/unzipped", overwrite = T)
  # read it
  hh <- read_csv(file.path("data/raw/unzipped", hh_name),
               na = "-9999",
               col_select = any_of(keep),
               col_types = cols(TIMESTAMP_START = "c", TIMESTAMP_END = "c", .default = "d"))
  hh$site <- str_extract(basename(hh_name), "[A-Z]{2}-[A-Za-z0-9]+") # add site id from file name
  return(hh)} # return clean table

zip_files <- list.files(here("data", "raw"), pattern = "\\.zip$", full.names = TRUE)

flux <- map_dfr(zip_files, read_hh) # apply the functiont to each one and combine results
flux <- flux |> mutate(time = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP_START, format = "%Y%m%d%H%M", tz = "UTC"))
flux[flux == -9999] <- NA
```

# merge data
```{r}
# one row per site for flux data
flux_static <- flux |>
  mutate(across(c(TA_F, P_F), ~ na_if(.x, -9999))) |>
  mutate(year = year(time)) |>
  group_by(site, year) |>
  summarise(annual_mean_temp = mean(TA_F, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(flux_mean_temp = mean(annual_mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  rename(site_id = site)

worldclim <- read_csv(here("data/external/worldclim/worldclim_bio_my_sites.csv"))

soil_texture <- read_csv(here("data/external/soilgrids/soilgrids_my_sites.csv")) |>
  filter(property == "sand", bottom_cm <= 30) |>
  group_by(site_id) |>
  summarise(
    sand_topsoil = weighted.mean(mean, (bottom_cm - top_cm), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

site_analysis <- flux_static |>
  left_join(worldclim, by = "site_id") |>
  left_join(soil_texture, by = "site_id") |>
  mutate(temp_diff = flux_mean_temp - BIO1)

site_complete <- site_analysis |>
  filter(!is.na(temp_diff) & !is.na(sand_topsoil))

summary(site_complete)
View(site_complete)

cat("Towers with complete data:", nrow(site_complete), "\n")
cat("Excluded:", site_analysis$site_id[is.na(site_analysis$temp_diff)], "\n\n")
```

# Temp deviation from WorldClim normal

```{r}
# Calculate summary stats for temperature
temp_summary <- site_complete |>
  summarise(
    n_towers = n(),
    mean_flux_temp = round(mean(flux_mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_worldclim_temp = round(mean(BIO1, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    mean_temp_diff = round(mean(temp_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_temp_diff = round(sd(temp_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min_temp_diff = round(min(temp_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max_temp_diff = round(max(temp_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(temp_summary)
```

# Sand content vs Temperature deviation

```{r}
cor_test <- cor.test(site_complete$sand_topsoil, site_complete$temp_diff, 
                     method = "pearson")

lm_sand <- lm(temp_diff ~ sand_topsoil, data = site_complete)

cat("\n--- Sand vs Temperature Deviation ---\n")
cat("n =", nrow(site_complete), "towers\n")
cat("r =", round(cor_test$estimate, 3), "\n")
cat("p-value =", round(cor_test$p.value, 3), "\n")
cat("R-squared =", round(summary(lm_sand)$r.squared, 3), "\n")
cat("Slope =", round(coef(lm_sand)[2], 3), "°C per % sand\n")
cat("Intercept =", round(coef(lm_sand)[1], 3), "\n")
```

# Plot

```{r}
ggplot(site_complete, aes(x = sand_topsoil, y = temp_diff)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = site_id), vjust = -1.5, size = 3.5) +  # label only here
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Soil Sand Content vs. Temperature Deviation from 1970–2000 Normal",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(site_complete), " towers (US-Myb excluded: no WorldClim/SoilGrids pixel)"),
    x = "Topsoil Sand Content (%)",
    y = "Temperature Deviation (°C)\n(FLUXNET mean − WorldClim BIO1)",
    caption = paste0("r = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 2),
                     " | p = ", round(cor_test$p.value, 3),
                     " | slope = ", round(coef(lm_sand)[2], 3),
                     " °C per % sand")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10))
```

  arrange(desc(temp_diff)))
